"text": "Review criteria:\n- Confirm which accounts, policies, plans, or registration types require beneficiary review.\n- Compare current beneficiary records against Lena Copperwisp’s stated intent and estate planning notes.\n- Verify full legal names, relationships, percentage allocations, contingent beneficiaries, and per stirpes or per capita elections where applicable.\n- Confirm allocations total correctly and do not conflict with account or custodian rules.\n- Identify whether spouse consent, trustee information, minor beneficiary handling, or legal review is needed.\n- Document any discrepancy, missing signature, or follow-up required before marking the update complete.\nLena Copperwisp noted that Marcus Copperwisp remains listed as primary beneficiary on her IRA and term life policy, and the estate summary indicates the children and trust as the intended backstop.",

"text": "Complete the following checks:\n- Identify the position, account location, cost basis, holding period, and percentage of total investable assets.\n- Confirm whether the holding is employer stock, inherited stock, restricted equity, a legacy position, or a tax-sensitive lot.\n- Review unrealized gain or loss, dividend exposure, liquidity needs, and any trading restrictions or blackout windows.\n- Evaluate tax-aware diversification options, including staged sales, gifting, charitable strategies, exchange funds if appropriate, or hedging considerations.\n- Compare concentration risk against the client’s financial plan, retirement income needs, and risk tolerance.\n- Document recommended next steps, required approvals, and any CPA or legal coordination needed before transactions.\nLena Copperwisp is concerned about the Paper Otter Technologies stock representing a large share of investable assets and wants a risk review given the change in household income.",
